name: spendwise
description: Enterprise-Quality Personal Expense Tracker Web Application focused on Indian users and UPI transactions
author: SpendWise Team

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
